hero.title: Study Computer Science in Switzerland
hero.subtitle: Pursuing a **Masters in Computer Science Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students** is a great option for those students who want to pursue higher studies in computing, software development, artificial intelligence, data science, and cybersecurity.

overview:
Switzerland is a favorite destination for Indian students wishing to pursue a master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity or any other related technology fields. Swiss universities are known for their research-led education, strong ties with technology companies and opportunities to work on advanced computing projects.

Students should be aware that depending on the university, the program may be called Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Computer Science and Engineering. Please check the particular program title, admission requirements, language of instruction and eligibility for international students before applying.

Currency conversion was CHF 1 ≈ INR 110\. This is a planning rate estimate. University fees and exchange rates may change.

**Masters in Computer Science Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students** provides an opportunity to explore advanced computing specializations and research-oriented education.

faq.question: Is IELTS or TOEFL mandatory for studying Computer Science in Switzerland?
faq.answer: Requirements vary by institution and program level. English-taught programs generally require IELTS (6.5+) or TOEFL (90+), while German/French programs require proof of proficiency at B2/C1 levels.

faq.question: Can Indian students work part-time while studying Computer Science in Switzerland?
faq.answer: Yes, international students are permitted to work up to 15 hours per week during academic semesters and full-time during official vacation periods after completing 6 months of study in Switzerland.

faq.question: What is the average tuition fee for Computer Science in Swiss public universities?
faq.answer: Public universities in Switzerland offer highly subsidized tuition, typically ranging from CHF 1,000 to CHF 4,000 per year, making it one of the most cost-effective study destinations in Europe.

faq.question: Are degrees from Swiss universities recognized globally and in India?
faq.answer: Yes, degrees awarded by Swiss cantonal and federal universities are accredited by the Swiss government and recognized globally, including by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and international employers.
